name: Infrastructure Issues
description: Timeouts, network errors, or environment problems unrelated to application logic.

name: Known Defects
description: Expected failures linked to known product defects (for example tests marked with test.fail()).
messageRegex: .*(Security Defect|Known Defect|ParaBank uses POST|expected to fail|expected fail).*

name: Unexpected Failures
description: Tests that were expected to pass but failed. These require immediate investigation.
